description: Up to four wins from the last 30 days, each with kind (page, query, keyword or backlink), title, detail and stat: the most-cited page, the biggest citation-rate jump for a query, the biggest Google ranking climb and the best new backlink, leaving out links hidden as spam. A win with nothing to show is left out. Null, with a hint, until the Reports screen is turned on (activate_analytics_screen).
name: get_top_wins
